thesis.statement: We believe the organization cannot manage technical debt effectively because debt has historically been treated as a local team concern with no standardized process for identification, scoring, or cross-BU visibility — and cross-team project dependencies have now made this an organizational-level risk that no single team can manage alone.

openQuestions: What is the actual cross-team project delay baseline?
Who will own the tech debt governance process?
Do all BUs define 'tech debt' the same way?
assumptions: Teams will adopt a centralized tool if mandated
ADO export is sufficient for scheduling
